depends_on: prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions (mod 10)
notes: Partial: the greedy sequence never terminates (PNT for primes == 1 mod 10 gives a prime 10(C 10^d + m) + 1 with m of d digits for large d). Every-number-appears is open: equivalent to primes in the orbit C_n 10^(d+1) + 10u + 1 of the least unused u. Outside Lean: the whole argument (PNT in APs missing from Mathlib).
